thread:
emma: Heads-up: Enterprise ops asked for a "Pinned Commitment" product — not just pin TTL but a contractual offering with retention, region guarantees, and a migration escrow. Can we sketch required gates?
raj: What are the customer musts?
emma: From the intake: 1) Up to 180d pin with regional residency (EU), 2) guaranteed p95 latency cap, 3) migration escrow credits if we retire early, 4) emergency unpin SLA and comm windows.
sam: We should call this offering "Pinned Commitment" (PC). Proposal: two SKUs: PC-Standard (90d) and PC-Extended (180d). Extended requires reservation on premium hardware and a signed SOW.
claire: Bench & quality gates: canonical harness = 512 seq, 200 eval samples. Acceptance: gen p95 <= 140ms for Extended, <= 220ms for Standard. Semantic drift (embedding cos sim) <= 3.5% on the eval set.
raj: Important: define retention of model artifacts + telemetry per tenant and KMS notes for Private installs. Legal: need explicit limits of liability if third-party model upstream changes.
legal: We'll add a clause: "If model upstream changes materially and causes safety or quality regressions, Redwood may require pin suspension; customer will receive migration credits per the escrow schedule."
infra-bot: Created infra ticket INFRA-8421 to reserve capacity mapping for Extended pins.
claire: Preflight CI checklist: bench harness pass, regression eval, smoke routing, canary traffic test (5% traffic for 48h). All must be green before pin activation.
emma: Migration escrow idea: allocate credits equal to X days of reserved capacity; use migration-orchestrator to run retargeting and data transfer. Recommend 60 days free migration credits on first migration.
raj: UI/API: pin_reason, pin_tier, region_constraint, opt_in_strict_fallback. Expose TTL countdown and request-extension flow in Console.
sam: Fallback behavior: default = attempt compatible fallback variant then notify. Strict mode = no fallback, immediate 503 on variant mismatch. Document both.
legal: Also require audit metadata: pinned_by, approval_ticket, signed_sow_id (if Extended), and pin_change_history retained for 2 years.
emma: Timeline & owners: spec draft this week (sam), bench checklist (claire), registry flags (raj), legal stub (legal). Canary target: 6 tenants across regions next quarter. We'll use this thread as canonical notes.
